name: Green Cabinets NY
subtitle: Design your kitchen in 3D
promotionalText: Design your new kitchen in 3D: type your sizes or scan the room, try real Tafisa, Shinnoki and Egger finishes, and see the price before the first visit.
description:
Custom kitchen cabinets, vanities, closets and millwork for New York homes, designed in Bushwick since 2009. Plan your kitchen from your own room, pick real materials, and get real prices before the first visit.

DESIGN YOUR NEW KITCHEN IN 3D
Pick your kitchen's shape (one wall, L, U or galley) and set how long the walls are, or scan the room on an iPhone Pro. The app puts new cabinets on your walls in 3D: the sink under the window, the dishwasher beside it, the range with its hood, the fridge, wall cabinets and a stone countertop. It follows the NKBA kitchen planning guidelines that designers use and shows you which ones the plan meets. Try door colors and Raphael Stone countertops right on the cabinets, and see the price from our published rates. The drawings name every cabinet, ready for our designers.

START HERE: THREE STEPS
1. Show us your room. 2. Pick what you love. 3. Send it to us. The app walks you through it and ticks each step off. We reply within 24 hours.

CABINETS IN YOUR ROOM, IN AR
Stand in your kitchen and place real-size base, drawer, wall and pantry cabinets with the camera. Drag them into place, line up a run, and switch between shaker, slim shaker, flat panel and raised panel doors. Try real finishes from Tafisa, Shinnoki and Egger, our paint colors and stains, and see a stone countertop on your base cabinets. Take pictures as you go. Works on any recent iPhone or iPad.

REAL MATERIALS
The panels we build with: Tafisa laminates, Shinnoki real wood veneers and Egger European finishes, plus Wilsonart, AGT, solid hardwoods, paint colors and stains, and Raphael Stone countertops at $65 per square foot. Start with our picks for each, or open the whole collection with product codes.

MATCH A COLOR
Saw a color you love in a magazine or a friend's kitchen? Take a photo, drag the circle onto the color, and the app finds the closest real panels. Or we paint your cabinets that exact color.

YOUR DESIGN BOARD
Everything you make and pick, on one page: your AR pictures, room drawings, finishes and sizes. Save it to Photos, print it, or share it with anyone helping you decide.

MEASURE WITH THE CAMERA
A tape measure in your camera for walls, gaps and windows, in feet and inches, inches or centimeters.

SCAN THE WHOLE ROOM
On an iPhone or iPad with LiDAR, walk your kitchen for about two minutes. See the room in 3D and as a floor plan with every size, then choose the walls for new cabinets, kitchen or closets, and see the price.

SCAN YOUR DRAWINGS
Architect's plans, a building floor plan or a sketch on paper: the scanner finds the page, straightens it and sends it for a price.

REAL PRICES UP FRONT
Slide to the length of your cabinets and see what NYC kitchens that size cost with us.

SEE THE WORK
Kitchens, vanities, walk-in closets and built-ins. Pinch to look closer, share a look, or text us about it.

BUILT FOR NEW YORK BUILDINGS
Co-op and condo paperwork, certificates of insurance, freight elevators, quiet hours, crooked pre-war walls. We plan around your building from day one.

SIRI AND SHORTCUTS
Say "Measure a wall with Green Cabinets" or "Match a color with Green Cabinets", or put them on the Action button.

By appointment only. We bring door and finish samples to your home in Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens and Staten Island.
reviewNotes:
Thank you for reviewing Green Cabinets NY. Following your 4.2 feedback we rebuilt the app from scratch as a fully native SwiftUI app. There is no web view anywhere in it.

Green Cabinets NY designs and installs custom kitchen cabinets in New York. The app is how clients plan a project from their own room. Everything below works on any recent iPhone or iPad, including devices without LiDAR.

TABS
Home: a three-step guide, the tools, our work, real panels, an interactive price check, how a project runs, and FAQs.
Our work: a photo gallery with native zoom transitions, pinch to zoom, swipe between photos, long-press menus and Share.
Plan: the native tools (below) and "Your project" with the Design board.
Materials: real supplier panels (Tafisa, Shinnoki, Egger, more), solid woods, paints and stains. Each has "See it in your room" in AR and "Add to quote". Supplier swatch photos load from the suppliers' own websites.
Quote: a native form that sends the request with everything made in the tools attached.

NATIVE TOOLS
1. Cabinets in your room (ARKit + RealityKit): tap "Open the camera", move over the floor, tap the floor to place a real-size cabinet. Drag to move, rotate with two fingers, "Add next" lines up a run, the top menu changes the door style, the round chips change the finish. The shutter takes pictures; Done adds them to the quote.
2. Measure with the camera (ARKit raycasting): point the ring at one end of a wall, tap +, move to the other end, tap + again.
3. Design your new kitchen (Home > Tools > Design my kitchen, or Plan). Works on every device: pick a shape (one wall, L, U, galley), set the wall lengths with the + and - buttons, tap "See my new kitchen". New cabinets appear on the walls in 3D (SceneKit) with the price, a door color and countertop picker, and the NKBA kitchen guideline checks. On LiDAR devices "Scan the room" (RoomPlan) leads to the same screen; on others "Try it on a sample room" opens a scanned sample: tap "Choose walls for new cabinets", tap walls 1 and 2, then "See my new kitchen". The Floor plan tab and the shared drawings show every cabinet by its catalog name.
4. Scan your drawings (VisionKit document camera).
5. Match a color (Materials tab, or Home > Tools): choose any photo, drag the circle, and the closest panels appear.
6. Design board (Home > Tools, or Plan > Your project): the share button saves it as a picture or prints it as a PDF.

Siri / Shortcuts: "Measure a wall with Green Cabinets", "Match a color with Green Cabinets". Long-press the app icon for quick actions.

Requests are emailed to our office. Text us opens the Messages sheet. There are no accounts, sign-in, purchases or ads. The camera is used only for these tools.

Contact: orders@greencabinetsny.com, (718) 804-5488.
